name: KDE Connect
description:
KDE Connect seamlessly integrates your Linux desktop with your smartphone and other computing devices. Built with secure encryption, it bridges communications across your local Wi-Fi network without relying on cloud services.

Features:
- Shared clipboard enabling instant copy-pasting between phone and PC
- Synchronized phone notifications with direct inline replying from the desktop
- Send and receive files, photos, and URLs instantly across paired devices
- Use your smartphone touchscreen as a wireless mouse trackpad and keyboard
- Media player remote control, SMS messaging, and phone battery level monitoring
